title: Concept: poetry.lock hash recorded as SHA-1
description: poetry.lock declares a locked file hash that uses SHA-1, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the hash cannot prove that the installed distribution is the reviewed one.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the hash cannot prove that the installed distribution is the reviewed one.
